=={{header|Cxc}}==

`Random` picks a secret in 0..99. Each round splits into `ask` (reads stdin, parses) and `check` (branches on the comparison). An empty or non-numeric guess ends the game.

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def main:
    use console: Console
    use random: Random
    secret: Int = 0

    -> starting
        secret => random.below(100) ?? 0
        console.write("Guess 0-99:")
        self :> ask

    starting <: ask -> starting
        let line: String! = console.readln() ?? ""
        let guess: Int! = line.to_int_or(-1)
        self :> check(guess)

    starting <: check(guess: Int):
        |:  guess < 0 -> end
            console.write("bye")
        |:  guess < self.secret -> starting
            console.write("higher")
            self :> ask
        |:  guess > self.secret -> starting
            console.write("lower")
            self :> ask
        |?: -> end
            console.write("correct!")
</syntaxhighlight>
